summary_short.zh: Self-Hosting Guide 是一份精心策划的资源集合，教你如何在自己的硬件或私有服务器上托管软件，涵盖云替代方案、大语言模型、家庭自动化、网络等主题。它的独特之处在于不仅列出工具，还通过结构化分类和实用建议传授自托管的设计原则——比如用 Docker 简化部署、用 WireGuard 保障安全连接。你可以把它当作路线图，从搭建 Home Assistant 智能家居开始，逐步替换 Google Drive、ChatGPT 等云服务，真正掌控自己的数据与隐私。

summaries.en: Self-Hosting Guide is a curated collection of resources for locally hosting software, covering everything from cloud alternatives and LLMs to home automation and networking. It excels as a structured, opinionated list that teaches you not just tools but the principles of self-sufficiency and privacy. Use it as a roadmap to set up your own services with Docker, WireGuard, or Home Assistant, and gain control over your digital life.

summary_short.zh: TeslaMate 是一款自托管的数据记录器，专为特斯拉车主设计，自动收集并可视化驾驶数据。它基于 Elixir/Phoenix 构建后端，使用 Grafana 展示仪表盘，数据存储在 PostgreSQL 中。技术亮点在于通过 MQTT 实现实时遥测，并集成 OpenStreetMap 进行路线映射。你可以通过 Docker 或 Nix 轻松部署，还能与家庭自动化系统联动。适合希望深度分析行程、电池状态和能耗的车主，完全掌控自己的数据，无需依赖特斯拉云端。

summaries.en: TeslaMate is a self-hosted data logger for Tesla vehicles that automatically collects and visualizes driving data. It uses Elixir/Phoenix for the backend and Grafana for dashboards, storing data in PostgreSQL. Technically, it leverages MQTT for real-time telemetry and integrates with OpenStreetMap for route mapping. You can deploy it via Docker or Nix, and extend it with home automation systems. Ideal for owners who want detailed analytics, trip history, and battery stats without relying on Tesla's cloud.

summary_short.zh: optimizerDuck 是一款免费开源的 Windows 优化工具，旨在提升系统性能、保护隐私并简化调优流程。它将数十种常见的注册表和服务调整整合到简洁的界面中，让游戏玩家和高级用户无需手动编写脚本即可轻松精简 Windows。你可以直接从 GitHub 运行它，禁用遥测、停止不必要的服务或应用游戏优化。其模块化设计鼓励贡献者添加新的优化项，你也可以 Fork 项目来构建自定义预设，满足个人或企业部署需求。

summaries.zh: optimizerDuck 是一款免费开源的 Windows 优化工具，旨在提升系统性能、保护隐私并简化调优流程。它将数十种常见的注册表和服务调整整合到简洁的界面中，让游戏玩家和高级用户无需手动编写脚本即可轻松精简 Windows。你可以直接从 GitHub 运行它，禁用遥测、停止不必要的服务或应用游戏优化。其模块化设计鼓励贡献者添加新的优化项，你也可以 Fork 项目来构建自定义预设，满足个人或企业部署需求。
summaries.en: optimizerDuck is a free, open-source Windows optimization tool designed to boost performance, enhance privacy, and simplify system tweaking. It consolidates dozens of common registry and service adjustments into a clean interface, making it easy for gamers and power users to debloat Windows without manual scripting. You can run it directly from GitHub to disable telemetry, stop unnecessary services, or apply gaming-focused tweaks. Its modular design invites contributors to add new optimizations, and you can fork it to build custom presets for your own deployment needs.
